speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant).

The clinical picture of new-onset disinhibition, apathy, hyperorality (cravings for sweets/fat), and rapid weight gain in a 55-year-old is classic for bvFTD. Given your 6-month history and lack of significant tremors or rigidity, this appears to be primarily behavioral rather than parkinsonian. No further diagnostic tests are required at this time.
